brand: VCCI — Liên đoàn Thương mại và Công nghiệp Việt Nam / Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry

geometry_relative_to_cap_height_H.note: Drum and first C share one centre; a fine ring of background separates them.

logo.clear_space_x: x = drum radius = 0.262 H on all sides
logo.plate_padding: x on all sides, Paper #FBF9F4, corner radius ≈ 0.03 H
rules: One colourway only: VCCI Blue letters + drum in master colours, on light grounds.
On blue, dark, photographic or busy grounds: place the logo on a Paper plate.
Never white letters (cultural rule), never gold letters, never a standalone drum as a logo substitute.
Never stretch, rotate, recolour, add effects, or redraw the logo.
The drum SVG in _Construction-only is for construction drawings and pattern design only.

Sky.role: support (chart series 2, light blue fields; Office theme accent 5)

colour.rule: One gold gesture per composition (a rule, a word, or a gold accent shape).
colour.grade_rule: Grade 0 = white, 100 = near black. Grade difference >= 40: 3:1 (large text, graphics); >= 50: 4.5:1 (AA body text); >= 70: 7:1 (AAA). Generated and checked by tools/assets/colour_system.py.

scales.note: Blue 5 = Blue Tint, Blue 30 = Sky, Blue 70 = VCCI Blue. Screen colours (sRGB); for offset print ask the printer to convert and proof.

status.rule: Strong tone for text, icons and borders (>= 4.5:1 on white, Paper and its background). Always with an icon and a word; status colours only signal status and never decorate.

dataviz.categorical_rule: Apply in this order; at most 6 series. More categories: group the smallest into one series or use small multiples. Drum Gold is never a series colour.

highlight.rule: One highlighted value in Drum Gold, always with its data label; other values VCCI Blue, or muted Slate 20 when there are many.

dataviz.sequential_rule: Ordered values and maps (e.g. PCI by province): light = low, dark = high.
dataviz.diverging_rule: Values around a reference: Bronze = below / decrease, Ivory = at the reference, Blue = above / increase.

chart_text.title: Lora Medium, states the message
chart_text.source: Be Vietnam Pro, caption size, below the chart

office_theme.note: Accents 1-5 follow the series order; a 6th series is set to Deep Navy by hand.

rules: Bar and column axes start at zero
Never encode meaning by colour alone: label series directly or add a legend and data labels
Cite the source under every chart

code.use: code, commands, file names (monospace; SIL OFL; quarto-vcci)

scale.heading: Lora Medium 40/48
scale.title: Lora SemiBold 28/36
scale.label: Be Vietnam Pro SemiBold 12, uppercase, tracking +22%

graphic_motifs: Drum-ring line art (concentric rings, ticks, dot band, 14-ray star)
C-arc pattern (the first C as a ring cut at +0.35R)

icons_interim.style: linear, 24×24 grid, 1.6 px stroke, round caps & joins, no fills
icons_interim.colour: VCCI Blue on light, Drum Gold on blue
icons_interim.status: to be replaced by the v1 icon set (step 2)
